answer:
1. Pledge Toggle: A simple switch next to Earn that locks your XNO/XMR into a bilateral bond, signaling availability to counterparties.

2. Premium Indicator: Displays the current market premium buyers pay for pledged inventory, showing the extra yield earned by locking funds.

3. Countdown-to-Maturity: Visual cards tracking the time remaining on each pledge, creating urgency and clarity around fund availability.

4. Penalty Preview: Before confirming a pledge, clearly display the 10% early-exit penalty amount so users understand the cost of breaking the bond.

5. Ladder Suggestions: Recommend splitting holdings into multiple smaller pledges with staggered maturities to balance liquidity needs with higher yields.

6. Realized Income History: Show a transparent ledger of past pledge income derived from the on-chain journal, proving actual returns without fake yield.

7. Sovereignty Badge: Prominent messaging stating 'Your Funds Never Leave Your Keys' alongside technical proof of the non-custodial architecture.

8. Early-Exit Clarity: Explicitly visualize how the 10% exit fee transfers to the staying counterparty, framing the penalty as direct compensation rather than a loss.

9. Maker Price Discovery: Allow users to set their own pledge terms, seeing real-time demand signals from takers who are willing to pay the specified premium.

10. Bond Status Dashboard: A real-time view of active mutual hostage bonds, showing which are healthy and which are nearing maturity.
methodology: Most people hide fees in abstract APY; instead show precise exit penalties and key sovereignty badges; because radical transparency builds trust in trustless systems.
baseline: Standard DeFi yield farming features like APY calculators, staking dashboards, and compound interest visualizations.
gaps: Item 10 ('Bond Status Dashboard') describes a passive monitoring view rather than an active 'UX/product framing' mechanism for attracting users or driving engagement like the other items (toggles, previews, suggestions). It is less of a 'framing' and more of a standard dashboard feature.
